How does HMPV spread?
HMPV spreads through:
•Direct contact (shaking hands, touching an infected person).
•Respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing.
•Touching contaminated surfaces and then touching your face (mouth, nose, or eyes).

nodes.text:
Who is at risk?
•Young children under 5 years old.
•Older adults over 65.
•People with chronic illnesses or weakened immune systems.
•Healthcare workers and caregivers due to close contact.

nodes.author: GHDeservesBest
nodes.text:
How can you protect yourself?
•Wash your hands frequently with soap and water for at least 20 seconds.
•Use alcohol-based hand sanitizers if soap isn’t available.
•Avoid close contact with sick individuals.
•Disinfect commonly touched surfaces regularly.
